title: For a finite type I in any universe and a family of schemes A_i in universe u, suppose each A_i is isomorphic to Spec D_i for a w-contractible commutative ring D_i in universe u
statement: For a finite type I in any universe and a family of schemes A_i in universe u, suppose each A_i is isomorphic to Spec D_i for a w-contractible commutative ring D_i in universe u. Then the scheme coproduct of the A_i is isomorphic to the spectrum of a w-contractible commutative ring in universe u.

source.place: Tag 09A1, lemma-w-contractible-hypercovering (2), finite unions of affine weakly contractible objects

proof.text: Reindex I along its equivalence with Fin (Nat.card I), so that the finite product of the coordinate rings stays in universe u. Apply the finite-product w-contractibility theorem. Mathlib sigmaSpec is an isomorphism for finite index types; compose its inverse with the coproduct of the chosen component isomorphisms and the coproduct reindexing isomorphism. For I empty the product is the zero ring and both schemes are empty.
